items.title: John Pope Interview, 1959-05-01
items.q: Or Chris Pelley? No, I don't remember that.

ctx.x: Yeah, people like that, they came over here.

Remember Buddy Petit? Did he play over here? Who's that Buddy Petit? No, I don't remember. Or Chris Pelley? No, I don't remember that. There's another man, an old time trumpet that told me once about your father, Bunk Johnson. Did you ever meet him? No, I don't think that either. Bunk Johnson. No, I don't think that either. They tell me once that your father, I've been told that they would play on Mardi Gras day, the boat would come in with some of the organizations. Did they do that?
Do you remember? Yes, I did. King, queen, they would come in.
